Questions about dryer repair

How much does a diagnosis cost?

Diagnosis is free when you proceed with a repair. A $149 diagnostic fee applies if you decide not to proceed with the repair.

Will I get a quote before the repair?

Yes. You’ll receive an upfront quote for parts and labor before any work begins.

Do you offer a warranty?

Our repairs come with a warranty of up to 5 years on parts and 90 days on labor.

Do you repair my type of dryer?

We service dryers from major brands. Call us if you have a question about your model.

What dryer problems can you help with?

We can help with not heating, not tumbling, slow drying, unusual noises, not starting, and other issues. Call us to discuss the problem.

What happens during my service visit?

Your technician will diagnose the problem and provide an upfront quote for parts and labor before any work begins.

Can I choose an appointment time?

When booking online, you can choose an available date and a 4-hour arrival window.

Can I get a same-day appointment?

Availability depends on your location and our schedule. Call us to ask about the soonest available appointment.
